asr.full_text: Do you have a 300 rand lying around and you're thinking it's too little for you to invest? Try some Stellar Lumens. Let me show you how. Hello and welcome to my channel. The videos that you are likely to see here are around the basics of Bitcoin Step one Deposit money into your altcoin trader account Once it is reflecting in your XAO Wallet Then you can start buying. On the home page You have to look on the right hand side at the different markets available and search for Stellar Lumens Select Stellar Lumens to open up the markets XLM is the short code for stellar lumens so you search for XLM. Once you have opened up the XLM marketplace, you will just go to the bottom and you will find where it says buy XLM, and you will see the price is ADRAN26 my character however on that side where it says sell X l m you can see the amount is Adrian 14 cents that means the person is willing to only pay Adrian 14 cents so they have to wait for someone who's going to sell it for that price you can pay that Adrian 26 to buy the coin and the coins will be transferred immediately into your xml wallet or else you can set your own price if you want to buy it for adrian 14 cents or below that then you can set the price as well but you just have to wait longer until your offer is accepted as you can see in the trade history there was someone who was willing to sell this coin for only a drug 7 cents another person sold it for 8 trend 15 cents so the price is going up my offer that i'm making is 8-round 14 cents and i will receive receive 38 XLM for a total of 311 rands. You click on, buy to confirm your offer. My generous offer to buy it for 8 Rand 14 cents is at the top. Everyone else is offering to pay less the lowest is R7.78.
